summary: Seed agent-authored Inbox asks for the isolated thread preview trial

replay.detail: The ignored setup test changes only the explicitly selected stopped scratch store.

schema.detail: Uses the existing production PersonAskRequest admission path.

rules.detail: No person pairing or person CLI writes are added. Existing stand-in Botanist and Surveyor agents author the two asks to the designated synthetic preview person.

compatibility.detail: Normal tests and production operation do not run the ignored scratch setup.

downtime.detail: Stop only the isolated preview scratch daemon before running seed_scratch_trial_asks; the test refuses a reachable scratch socket.

manual.detail: After seed_scratch_threads, run seed_scratch_trial_asks to add Preview trial: humidity calibration decision and Preview trial: frost cover decision. Idempotency keys are preview-trial-ask-calibration-v1 and preview-trial-ask-frost-v1; reseeding checks that the same source IDs are returned.

recovery.detail: Reset the scratch world from the person's offline baseline, then reseed; no live fleet state is involved.
